title: Neighborhood story cabinet and listening rights
titleZh: 社區故事櫃與聆聽方式
passage:
DOCUMENT 1 — Guidelines | Colburn Court Story Cabinet
Neighbors may leave recordings about the street in the story cabinet. Each card has a speaker space and a listening space. The speaker space gives the name to credit; the listening space says whether the story can be played aloud at a gathering or only through the cabinet headphones. “With headphones” does not stop listeners from leaving written comments.

If a story contains a second voice, the first version on the card is provisional until both people have agreed to the listening arrangement. Meanwhile, volunteers can keep it in the cabinet to rehearse with headphones, but they must not play any of it over a loudspeaker. The provisional mark applies to the entire recording, even a part in which only one person speaks.

Once the speakers agree, put the date on an updated card and keep the old card behind it. Do not write over the original under any circumstances. To see which arrangement is current, use the dated card on top, not the name printed on the recording.

DOCUMENT 2 — Messages before the courtyard gathering
Ed: The courtyard gathering needs one more recording. Mina's long interview card currently says “with headphones.” Her aunt appears for ten seconds near the end. I wonder if we could play the opening minute over the speaker.

Gita: Not from that recording. The aunt left the speaker space signed but did not reply about the listening arrangement. Mina also sent a different recording last month, “Rain on the Balcony,” in which she is the only voice. Her dated card for that recording says “play aloud.”

Ed: I'll use that one. Mina said she would rather not be credited by her full name at this gathering. The older card shows it, but the latest one shows Mina R. I'll bring the latest one along.
passageZh:
文件 1｜使用辦法｜柯爾本庭院故事櫃
鄰居可以把關於這條街的錄音留在故事櫃。每張卡都分為講述者欄和聆聽方式欄。講述者欄寫上應署名的人；聆聽方式欄寫明故事可在聚會中公開播放，還是只能用櫃上的耳機聽。「用耳機聆聽」不妨礙聽眾留下書面意見。

如果故事裡另有第二個聲音，兩位講述者都同意聆聽方式之前，卡上的第一版設定只能視為暫定。這段時間，志工可以把錄音留在故事櫃，用耳機做排練，但不能將任何片段用揚聲器播放。暫定標示適用於整段錄音，即使其中一部分只有一個人說話。

講述者同意後，在更新的卡上寫下日期，並把舊卡放在新卡後面。在任何情況下都不要在原卡上覆寫。要確認現在採用哪種聆聽方式，請看最上面那張有日期的卡，不要用錄音上印的人名來判斷。

文件 2｜庭院聚會前的訊息
艾德：庭院聚會還差一段錄音。米娜的長訪談卡現在寫著「用耳機聆聽」。訪談快結束時，她阿姨有十秒的發言。我在想，可不可以把開頭一分鐘用揚聲器播放。

吉塔：不能播那段。阿姨在講述者欄簽了名，卻沒有回覆聆聽方式。米娜上個月另送了一段叫做〈陽台上的雨〉的錄音，裡面只有她一個人的聲音。那段錄音有日期的卡上寫的是「可公開播放」。

艾德：那我會用那一段。米娜說這次聚會她不想用全名署名。舊卡上寫了全名，最新版的署名方式是「Mina R.」。我會把最新版那張帶來。
